==Notes==
This template is one in a series of modular source templates meant to be used to generate box-style navigation templates. It is meant to be [[m:Help:substitution|substituted]] and will not work properly if <code>subst:</code> is not present in the template call.

==Usage instructions==
<pre>{{Nav box start|text|background|width}}</pre>

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|text}}}} The title of the whole box and its contents.

===Optional parameters===
#<li value="2">{{Para||{{Var|background}}}} The color of the box background, default <code style="color:black; padding:0 5px 0 5px; background:#D8E9FC">#D8E9FC</code>.</li>
#{{Para||{{Var|width}}}} The box width, default automatic.
#{{Para|max}} The maximum box width, default none.
#{{Para|float}} The horizontal position of the box, default none (centered).

==Box-style navigation source templates==
*{{Tl|Nav box start}}
*{{Tl|Nav box heading}}
*{{Tl|Nav box}}
*{{Tl|Nav box end}}

==Example==
===Code===
<pre>
{{Nav box start|Navigation template test}}
{{Nav box|The 1st box is the deepest}}
{{Nav box|2 Boxy 2 Blurious}}
|-
{{Nav box|3 blind boxes}}
{{Nav box|Box box BOX bOX}}
{{Nav box end}}
</pre>

===Result===
{{Nav box start|Navigation template test}}
{{Nav box|The 1st box is the deepest}}
{{Nav box|2 Boxy 2 Blurious}}
|-
{{Nav box|3 blind boxes}}
{{Nav box|Box box BOX bOX}}
{{Nav box end}}
